listing.name: EarthBound Companion
listing.summary: Use a permitted existing Companion launcher with your own clean USA EarthBound ROM.

steps.title: Use the Companion launcher you are permitted to use
steps.instruction: Select EarthBound Companion.exe with its own folder as the working directory, then choose Play explicitly. Use its guided setup with your own clean USA EarthBound ROM. The launcher builds native game data and optional supported Redux content; Portcove does not run its helpers during discovery. This is a distinct implementation from nickclyde/EarthBoundRecomp and does not change that integration or retained contracts. If your existing launcher uses a custom data root, retain its --data-root argument and chosen directory when registering: enter --data-root and the directory as two separate argument lines. Otherwise it opens the default profile instead.

warnings: Make a normal in-game phone save before changing versions: quick states are build-specific, and runtime rollback does not restore earlier saves or guarantee older compatibility.
Fresh foundation redistribution/GPL qualification remains unresolved; a conditional existing-copy guide is not binary-distribution clearance.
Keep the complete actual Companion data root, including Game, Profiles, UserData, msu, settings, supported mods and generated content, backed up with the game closed.

references.title: Keep each edition and seed’s data together
references.instruction: The ordinary Windows build uses the launcher folder as its data root; portable/preview builds can use %LOCALAPPDATA%/EarthBoundCompanionPreview instead. Keep the complete actual Companion data root, including Game, Profiles, UserData, msu, settings, supported mods and generated content, backed up with the game closed. Original, Redux and generated seeds have separate save namespaces. Make a normal in-game phone save before changing versions: quick states are build-specific, and runtime rollback does not restore earlier saves or guarantee older compatibility. Use the launcher’s own supported backup/restore and migration controls; retain original ROMs and working runtimes separately.

references.title: Retain upstream ownership
references.instruction: The launcher and its helpers own preparation, version-specific content generation and replacement. Registration leaves every external file untouched and does not promise Portcove-managed update, backup, restore or rollback. Fresh foundation redistribution/GPL qualification remains unresolved; a conditional existing-copy guide is not binary-distribution clearance.

restrictions.explanation: Downloads are paused. The Windows package includes a native engine linked with Redux code. The project’s distribution notes say the combined engine still needs its native-engine terms and source obligations resolved. A clarified release or a package without that engine can be reviewed. You can register a permitted existing launcher and keep your own ROM and data folder.
